name: Usage dashboards and statuslines
summary: Third-party trackers, dashboards and statusline scripts that report token use and cost. Held: they only monitor, and native /usage and /cost cover it, including a cache line and warnings for always-on context and large results. A statusline command is executable configuration, which verify reports (EP-UNOWNED-EXECUTABLE-CONFIG).

evidence.source: docs/v8/02-landscape.md section 10 (native /cost cache line, 2.1.251; /usage warnings, 2.1.299 and 2.1.311)
evidence.setting: List of native features that replaced add-ons
evidence.effect: Native /cost shows cache use, and /usage flags large misses, always-on context and large results

maintenance: Many third-party tools, not tracked one by one.
